TradingMode.title: TradingMode
TradingMode.description: The three operating modes. ``PAPER`` is always the safe default.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Owner-declared static instrument lists, not a verified historical universe. Declared knowledge timestamps are checked against each window start; listing, delisting and universe completeness are externally unverified. Survivorship and selection bias remain possible.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Calendar span is not trading-session coverage. Recorded publication counts do not prove completeness, statistical confidence or profitability. Groww intraday history is limited by provider availability (project design: three months); longer research requires available local archives. External source coverage remains unverified.
